title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each point as its own cluster and merges the closest clusters step by step until the desired number of clusters is reached.

title: Identifying the Closest Clusters
text: Look at the distance matrix. The smallest distance between any two points indicates the first pair of clusters to merge.

title: Finding the Minimum Distance
text: In the distance matrix, find the smallest non-zero value. This will tell you which two points are closest.

title: Determine the First Merge
text: Which two points have the smallest distance between them?
